rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Referent resolution under a sequential deck read.
rules_evaluated.evidence: chunk 2 line 31: "the lead reads the judgment and rewrites" is the closest: "lead" is not named earlier, but line 11 names "the main session" as the rewriter and line 13 names "Helper agents", so the role resolves under a sequential read. Line 49 "The Debrief cuts that rule" binds in-sentence to "which rule's miss kept coming back" and Debrief is a canonical module section. Harm (unresolvable referent) absent.

line 21 "the judge from Module 5", line 9 "your Module 3 briefing": named by module and artifact, not by position; closest is line 67 "your five marks from Module 5", which names the beat. No "the opening lecture"-style callback.

Line 49 "The Debrief" exists at trainings/agents-101/evaluations.md:37 "## Debrief". Line 21 Module 5 judge: evaluations.md includes the bakeoff/judge beat. All backward refs resolve.

chunk 2 "Start the loop, then walk away" lines 31-43 is the closest (it also carries the parallel-search and analogy prompts), but those happen while the loop runs, so the header stays true. Chunk 5 "The loop improved it, not you" line 65 states exactly that.

no "Not X. Not Y. Z." (grep of body_numbered for "^Not |\. Not " -> 0 hits by read); line 59 "You edited none of it." is a single declarative; line 15 number is labelled "Example run note"; line 53 two parallel clauses is a pair, not a triple; line 35 three quoted remarks are examples, not an empty-leg verb triplet.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Internal dialect never lands on a slide.
rules_evaluated.evidence: closest: line 31 "the lead" and line 13 "Helper agents" are plain engineering vocabulary, and "Debrief" is a canonical section name. No compendium/surface-noun/firing/beat/mood on the body (maintainer block excluded).

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Emphasis budget — bold is for handles, and go very lightly.
rules_evaluated.evidence: chunk 6 "Put another judge in the same loop": line 75 "**Take-home: put any judge in a loop that improves the thing it scores.**" bolds a whole sentence, not a <=5-word handle; "Take-home" is not a widget in widgets.md (grep -> no hit) and no accept-note exists. Harm (bold monoculture/emphasis dilution) is mild but the rule says never a whole lead sentence. Other bold passes: line 11 "Eval as infrastructure" and line 13 "Helper agents" are coined-term handles, line 67 "Spot-check the judge." is a 3-word handle, "Time/What you do/What happened/The point" are widget labels.
rules_evaluated.fix_hint: Bold only the label: "**Take-home:** put any judge in a loop that improves the thing it scores."
